item.title: what i learned about infrastructure as code
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: infrastructure as code is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Infrastructure as code shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: thinking about infrastructure as code
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months infrastructure as code bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Infrastructure as code shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
